caption:
Most brands pay a creator, get one post, and never see that money again.

A partnership is a funnel, not a transaction. Here is the nine-step version:

1. The right creator — not the biggest audience, the one whose audience already buys what you sell
2. A real testimonial — they use the product first, because people can smell a script
3. An exclusive code — one code per creator, so you always know what came from where
4. A partnership page — their face on it, not your logo
5. The campaign — a full week of stories, not one post
6. Read the result by code — sales from that code against what you paid
7. Flat fee plus commission — now they want it to work as much as you do
8. Move the audience — their followers onto your list, reading your content next
9. Scale it — repeat exactly what worked with other creators in the same niche

Step 6 is the one almost everybody skips, and it is the only one that tells you whether any of it was worth the money.
